data.long_meaning: Arjumand is a name of Arabic, Persian and Urdu origin meaning 'Jasmine, beautiful garden'. This name is derived from the Persian word 'arjumand' meaning 'Jasmine, garden of love'. It is a name that evokes the beauty and grace of nature, particularly the fragrant and beloved jasmine flower. The name Arjumand carries the meaning “Jasmine, beautiful garden” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Urdu, Arabic, Persian. Parents who choose Arjumand usually hope their child will grow to embody jasmine, beautiful garden and live with faith, good character and purpose.
